description: This is a shell script used for testing the output format of 'git fetch' command under various configurations, including different output formats, remotes, references, and options like porcelain mode. It contains test cases that clone repositories, modify references, and verify the fetch output messages to ensure correct formatting and behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for the given command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the provided output is empty.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: git fetch
methods.description: Fetches updates from a remote repository.

methods.name: git reset
methods.description: Resets current HEAD to a specified state.

methods.name: git remote set-url
methods.description: Changes the URL of a remote.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit for testing.
